title: Peak-Fermentation Activity Ranking
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brew:fermentation
| streamstats current=f last(gravity) as prev by batch
| eval drop=prev-gravity
| stats max(drop) as peak_drop, avg(temp_c) as temp by batch
| sort - peak_drop
description: Ranks your batches by their most vigorous fermentation day, a fun way to compare how lively different yeasts and recipes were.
value: Comparing peak activity across batches teaches you which yeast and temperature combinations ferment hardest for next time.
implementation: Ingest gravity per batch; compute the biggest daily drop and rank batches by peak activity.
visualization: Bar chart of peak daily gravity drop by batch.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which of your beer batches fermented most vigorously, which is a fun way to compare recipes.
